name: Death Of Loved Ones
overview: Scripture teaches that while death is the consequence of sin, believers have the assurance of eternal life through faith in Jesus Christ, who is the way to the Father and the source of life. The death of loved ones is met with both sorrow and hope, as Jesus promises that those who belong to God will be like the angels and will not die again, being children of the resurrection. God's enduring mercy invites us to give thanks even in the midst of loss, trusting in His gift of everlasting life rather than perishing.
